'''Rantoul station''' is an [[Amtrak]] intercity train station in [[Rantoul, Illinois]], United States, on their {{lnl|Amtrak|Illini/Saluki}} service. It was originally built by the [[Illinois Central Railroad]]. The ''[[City of New Orleans (train)|City of New Orleans]]'' also uses these tracks, but does not stop.
